classifier.description: "clef" or "clef-flash" (Cloudflare Workers AI), or any pi classifier as provider/id, e.g. "typesafe/jev-latest".

accountId.description: Cloudflare account for Clef. Detected from your login when unset.

pool.description: Models the router may use, as provider/id. Unset: the newest model of each well-known family you have access to.

providers.description: Restrict auto-discovery to these providers, in order of preference.

strengths.description: e.g. feature, frontend, debugging, architecture, writing, long_context

kinds.description: Task kinds, merged over the built-ins (question, small_change, feature, frontend, debugging, architecture, large_context, writing) by name.

desc.description: What counts as this kind. The classifier reads this.

prefer.description: Strengths to prefer within the tier.

fallback.description: Model when the classifier is unavailable at the start of a session.

direct.description: Model for compaction summaries and other out-of-loop requests.
